Alerts

Alerts are late or do not sound on Android

Android saves battery by holding back apps' alarms. Check these, in order:

  1. Notifications: Settings → Alerts must not show "Notifications are off for this app in the phone's settings". If it does, tap Allow, or turn notifications on for Taqwim in the phone's settings.
  2. Exact alarms: if the Alerts tab says "Alerts may come a few minutes late: allow the app to set exact alarms", tap Allow and switch on Alarms & reminders for Taqwim.
  3. Battery: in the phone's settings, open Apps → Taqwim → Battery and choose Unrestricted (the names vary by phone maker). Some phones also have their own list of "sleeping" or "optimised" apps; take Taqwim out of it.
  4. Volume: the Athan plays at the phone's alarm volume. Make sure it is not at zero.
  5. The alert itself: in Settings → Alerts, check that At the time is on for that prayer and that its Sound is not Silent.

An alert that the phone delivers more than 10 minutes late does not sound on purpose; it leaves a silent notification with the prayer and its time.

Only part of the Athan plays on my iPhone

iOS plays at most 30 seconds of a notification's sound. The full Athan plays in full on Android only. On iPhone, the short Athan takbirs fit within this limit.

I get no alerts at all on my computer or in the browser

Alerts work on Android, iPhone and iPad only for now. The Alerts tab on other devices says "Notifications work on Android and iPhone; they do not reach this device yet".

Alerts stopped after many days

Taqwim sets the coming alerts (up to 60) each time you open it. If you do not open it for a long time, the list runs out. Open Taqwim at least once a week.

Location

Taqwim cannot find my location

  • The message says why; see the table in Getting started.
  • Allow location for Taqwim in the device settings, then tap Use my location (or Try GPS again on the first launch).
  • Most computers have no GPS: choose your city from the list, tap a point on the map, or type the coordinates.
  • In the web version, location only works on a secure (https://) address.

The place name is a village or neighbourhood near me

GPS gives a point, and Taqwim names the nearest place in its database. In Settings → Location, tap Not this place? and choose the place you mean. The coordinates, and so the times, stay the same.

The times are for another time zone

Taqwim always shows times in the time zone of the chosen place. If you travel, change the place. Settings → Location warns when the place's zone differs from your device's.

Prayer times

My mosque's times differ from Taqwim's

  1. Check the method line under the times. Choose the method your mosque follows in Settings → Prayer → Calculation method.
  2. Check Asr time: Standard or Hanafi.
  3. If a few minutes still differ, use Time offsets in minutes to match the local timetable.
  4. Rounding can also move a time by up to a minute.

A time shows a dash (—)

The event does not happen at your place that day, which is common far from the equator in summer. Choose a High-latitude rule other than None in Settings → Prayer to get a time from a share of the night.

The Hijri date

The Hijri date differs by a day from my local calendar

This is normal. The Hijri month begins with the sighting of the new crescent, which depends on where you are and on the weather, while Taqwim's Hijri calendars are computed:

  • Umm al-Qura follows Saudi Arabia's official table.
  • Tabular (civil) and Tabular (astronomical) follow a fixed rule; the astronomical one is usually a day ahead of the civil one.

To match your local calendar, set Settings → Calendar → Hijri adjustment to +1 or −1 (up to ±3). The Islamic occasions follow the same setting.

To see when the crescent can be seen, open Calendar → Moon → Crescent. See Sky, Moon and astronomy.

No Hijri date is shown

The Umm al-Qura calendar covers the years 1300 to 1600 AH only. For dates outside them, choose a tabular calendar in Settings → Calendar.

Qibla and compass

The compass direction looks wrong

  • Move the phone in a figure-eight, away from metal, cars, magnets and electrical devices.
  • On a sunny day, use Correct with the Sun on the Qibla locator, or switch to the Sun method, which needs no compass.
  • On iPhone and iPad, tap Enable compass if it appears.
  • If Taqwim says "Large error: move away from metal and magnets", the place you stand in disturbs the sensor.

There is no compass on my computer

Computers usually have no compass sensor. The dial then stays with north at the top. Use the Qibla bearing in degrees with a real compass, the Sun method, or the Map.

Maps and mosques

The map is blank or says "No connection"

The street map needs a connection unless the area is saved. Download your area in advance: Qibla map → Offline areas. The built-in world map with borders always works offline. The web version has no offline areas.

Nearby mosques are missing or the list is short

  • Turn on Use the internet for street data (mosques and directions) at the bottom of the panel, and go online.
  • Offline, the mosques need an area saved at full detail: choose a smaller radius.
  • If a mosque is missing from the map data, add it yourself with Add a mosque.

Installing and settings

Windows says "Windows protected your PC"

The installer is not code-signed yet. Choose More info, then Run anyway.

macOS will not open Taqwim

The first time, Control-click Taqwim in Applications and choose Open, or go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

Numbers or the clock look different from what I expect

Change Settings → App → Digits (Eastern Arabic or Western digits) and Settings → General → Clock (12-hour or 24-hour).

How do I move my settings to a new phone?

Make a backup on the old device and restore it on the new one. See Backup and restore.

Can I start again from the first launch?

Settings → App → Reset all settings returns every setting to its default but keeps your current place, so the first launch does not repeat. To start completely fresh, clear the app's data in the device settings.
